# t12.1 — MockWebServer HTTPS test setup and shared Gradle verification

## Summary

The current MockWebServer fixture is configured to use explicit `127.0.0.1` cleartext with `allowCleartextForLocalDebug = true`; this is important because this host's reverse-DNS canonical hostname is not reliably loopback. The fixture therefore passes the API client's HTTPS policy without weakening release/default transport requirements.

Added a regression test asserting that the local-debug opt-in still rejects cleartext for a non-loopback host. Reran the full shared Gradle suite with task execution forced; all unit tests passed, and debug/release builds plus instrumentation APK compilation/package passed. No backend, production transport, or release configuration was changed.

## Change

- `android/app/src/test/java/com/nutria/app/data/remote/NutriaApiClientTest.kt` — added `localDebugOptInStillRejectsRemoteCleartextHosts`, guarding that explicit debug HTTP is still loopback-only.
- Existing setup continues to build a URL directly from `127.0.0.1` and the MockWebServer port rather than trusting MockWebServer's reverse-DNS-derived host.
- No production sources or API contracts changed.
